classes.formal_invariant: must be derivable within a declared formal system; no empirical or normative promotion
classes.operational_rule: must name a procedure, scope, inputs, outputs, and failure behavior
classes.normative_principle: must name affected authorities, values, contestability, and non-enacted status
classes.heuristic: must remain defeasible and cannot inherit law-like necessity
classes.empirical_hypothesis: requires preregistered observable predictions, data, fit, uncertainty, and independent review
classes.category_barrier: marks an invalid or unauthorized mapping and blocks inference
